unresolved.first_comment: all supported OS provide a mechanism for watching a filesystem for changes without polling. we cannot be walking the filesystem and stat'ing files every 0.05 seconds. the comments say stat is cheap, but i disagree; we should be subscribing to changes in the file tree (it could be from the whole root, but probably better to subscribe to individual files and directories that we're explicitly watching -- i know recursive change_notify on windows can be slow in large trees). we can fall back to polling, but it shouldn't be the first choice.
